2261.name: On The Cliffside

up.description: To the up lies Before The Gates Of Mahn-Tor.

down.description: To the down lies The Edge Of The Frigid Wastes.

2261.description:
A narrow shelf of grey rock clings to the cliffside, scoured by a wind
that never quite stops howling. Loose scree skitters off the lip into a
long, giddy drop to the valley floor. A wind-bitten trail winds down
toward the Edge Of The Frigid Wastes, its stones swept bare and open to
any who dare it. Above, a steep, much-trodden path climbs up toward the
gates of Mahn-Tor.

10100.name: The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor

east.description: To the east lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

west.description: To the west lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10100.description:
A narrow lane runs between stone-walled gardens and the backs of houses,
the cobbles patched with beaten earth. A broken cart wheel leans against
a wall, silvered with age. The lane carries on east and west. Wind-
twisted pines grow from clefts above the rooftops, and somewhere a
shutter bangs.

10101.name: The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor

east.description: To the east lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10101.description:
The lane turns a corner beside a low retaining wall, below which the
mountain falls away in terraces of grey rock. A stand of withered bean-
poles sticks up from a small kitchen plot. The street runs east and
south from here. A thin line of chimney smoke curls from a nearby roof
and is torn away by the wind.

10102.name: The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor

north.description: To the north lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10102.description:
A quiet street, straight and steep, flanked by narrow stone cottages
with slate roofs weighted by rocks against the wind. Doorways are low
and the doors painted a faded blue. The street climbs north and descends
south. A child's wooden hoop lies abandoned against a step.

10103.name: The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor

north.description: To the north lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies A Crossing in Mahn-Tor.

10103.description:
The street widens a little, and a stone well with a rope-worn lip stands
in a recess of the wall. Cart ruts cut deep grooves in the cobbles,
brimming with pooled water. The way north leads up the lane, and south
lies a crossing of ways. A carved lintel above the nearest door bears a
hammer and anvil.

10104.name: A Crossing in Mahn-Tor

north.description: To the north lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor West.

10104.description:
Four ways meet at a worn stone crossing marked by a weathered mile-post
carved with the keep's sigil. Traders' carts have left deep ruts in the
cobbles, and the wind rattles the shutters of the nearest houses. The
street runs north and south, and a wide road leads west into Mahn-Tor
West. A lamp-post of black iron stands at the corner.

10105.name: A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper

north.description: To the north lies A Crossing in Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper.

10105.description:
A busy street of tall narrow houses, their ground floors given over to
workshops with signs of boot and barrel. Smoke from forges and bakeries
hangs in the cold air. The crossing lies north, and the street goes on
south. Grey puddles stand in the hollows between the paving stones.

10106.name: A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper

north.description: To the north lies A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper.

east.description: To the east lies A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper.

10106.description:
The street bends sharply, curling around a squat stone tower whose
windows are stuffed with straw. Iron rings for tethering horses are
bolted to the wall, and a trough of frozen water sits beneath. The
street runs north toward the crossing and turns east. A faded decree,
torn at the corners, flaps from a nail.

10107.name: A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper

east.description: To the east lies A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper.

west.description: To the west lies A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper.

10107.description:
A straight, level stretch of street between rows of timber-framed shops,
their shutters painted in dull red and green. Barrels of nails and
bundles of rope stand beneath the eaves. The street runs east toward the
market and west back to the bend. The cobbles shine with a slick of damp
from the morning mist.

10108.name: A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

west.description: To the west lies A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper.

10108.description:
The street broadens as it approaches the market, and stalls of canvas
and rough boards crowd its edges. The sound of haggling drifts along on
the wind, and a smell of roasting chestnuts and hot iron fills the air.
The market square lies east, and the street runs back west. A lamp on a
post sways and creaks.

10109.name: Mahn-Tor Market Square

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

south.description: To the south lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor Proper.

west.description: To the west lies A Street in Mahn-Tor Proper.

10109.description:
The market opens here into a wide paved square ringed with merchants'
booths under patched awnings. Barrels of salted fish and crates of
onions are piled beside stalls selling pots and knives. The square
continues north and east, a small house stands south, and a street leads
west. A banner of the Lord hangs from a pole in the centre, snapping in
the wind.

10110.name: Mahn-Tor Market Square

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Gathering Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

west.description: To the west lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor Proper.

10110.description:
The middle of the market square, where a worn stone block serves as a
stand for criers and auctioneers. Smoke rises from a brazier where hot
pies are sold. The square runs east and south, a small house stands
west, and the doors of the gathering hall rise north. Straw and cabbage
leaves are trampled into the cobbles.

10111.name: Mahn-Tor Market Square

north.description: To the north lies A Mahn-Tor Trading Post.

east.description: To the east lies A Mahn-Tor Residence.

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

10111.description:
Canvas booths give way here to sturdy stone fronts at the busiest corner
of the market. A trading post stands to the north, a residence to the
east, and the square runs south and west. Crates of furs and sacks of
salt are stacked against the walls. A dented scale hangs from a post,
chiming in the wind.

10112.name: Mahn-Tor Market Square

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

east.description: To the east lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor Proper.

south.description: To the south lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor Proper.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

10112.description:
The market's quiet corner, where stalls of woven baskets and clay jars
crowd against a wall. A cobbler's bench stands under a canvas awning,
its tools laid out in rows. The square runs north and west, with small
houses east and south. Wind pushes at the awnings until they bulge like
sails.

10113.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor Proper

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

10113.description:
A snug home that smells of tanned leather, with hides stretched on
frames along one wall. A workbench holds awls, needles and a bowl of
waxed thread, and a stool sits beside it. The market square lies east
through the door. A small window rattles in the wind.

10114.name: Mahn-Tor Gathering Hall

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

10114.description:
A broad timbered hall with long tables, heavy benches and a stone hearth
big enough to roast an ox. Banners of the town's guilds hang from the
rafters beside rusted trophies of past campaigns. The market square lies
south through the double doors. The floor is scrubbed pale, and the
smell of woodsmoke and spilled mead lingers.

10115.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor Proper

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

10115.description:
A narrow house with a sooty chimney, where a kettle sings above a banked
fire. Two rocking chairs face the hearth, and a crooked shelf of chipped
cups hangs above. The market square lies north through the door. Rain-
stains map the ceiling in brown rings.

10116.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor Proper

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

10116.description:
A cramped house with whitewashed walls, a ladder to a sleeping loft, and
strings of dried peppers over the hearth. A shelf holds a few carved
wooden saints and a candle in a clay cup. The square lies north through
the door. Everything smells of garlic and woodsmoke.

10117.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor Proper

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

10117.description:
A small one-room house with a low roof of black beams and a floor of
beaten clay. A bed with a patchwork quilt, a spinning wheel and a
cooking pot on the hearth fill nearly every inch. The market square lies
west through the door. A peat fire smoulders, filling the room with
sweet smoke.

10118.name: A Mahn-Tor Residence

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

10118.description:
A tidy home with a plastered ceiling and a good table set with pewter
plates. A tall clock ticks beside a dresser of blue crockery, and a rag
rug warms the floor. The market lies west through the narrow front door.
The scent of baked bread and beeswax is homely.

10119.name: A Mahn-Tor Trading Post

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Market Square.

10119.description:
Pelts, snowshoes, coils of rope and bundles of iron nails fill the
cramped trading post. A counter of rough planks is piled with tallies,
and a map of the mountain trails is pinned behind it. The market lies
south through the door. The air smells of wet fur, tar and pipe tobacco.

10120.name: Mahn-Tor West

east.description: To the east lies A Crossing in Mahn-Tor.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor West.

10120.description:
The road leaves the crossing and runs on into a quieter quarter, where
houses stand shoulder to shoulder with tight little yards. A stone slab
bearing an old dedication leans in a wall niche. The crossing lies east,
and the road continues west. The wind carries the sound of a distant
bell.

10121.name: Mahn-Tor West

north.description: To the north lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor West.

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor West.

south.description: To the south lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor West.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor West.

10121.description:
A junction of the western quarter, where two small houses face each
other across the street. Window boxes hold hardy herbs, bent flat by the
wind. The road runs east and west, one door opens north and another
south. Ropes of drying onions hang from a beam over a stoop.

10122.name: Mahn-Tor West

north.description: To the north lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor West.

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor West.

south.description: To the south lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor West.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor West.

10122.description:
The street is wider here, paved in broken slabs and bordered by a low
drainage channel. Two houses with slate roofs flank it, one to the north
and one to the south. The road runs east and west. A knot of rope and a
wooden bucket mark a communal well beside the wall.

10123.name: Mahn-Tor West

north.description: To the north lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor West.

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor West.

south.description: To the south lies A Small House in Mahn-Tor West.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor West.

10123.description:
The road dips slightly, its stones slick with moss in the shadow of
high-walled houses. A small shrine niche with a clay lamp is set in a
wall. Doors open north and south, and the road runs east and west. The
wind brings a smell of incense from the temple quarter.

10124.name: Mahn-Tor West

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor West.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10124.description:
The street ends at the edge of the temple quarter, where the houses give
way to a long colonnade of weathered pillars. Fallen leaves chase each
other across the cobbles. The road runs back east, and west it opens
into the temple square. Incense and cold stone scent the air.

10125.name: Mahn-Tor Temple Square

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor West.

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10125.description:
A vast hall of grey columns forms the temple square, roofed in shadow
and echoing with whispered prayers. Candles in iron stands flicker on
the flagstones. Ways lead north and south through the colonnade, and
east a doorway opens to the street. A lamp burns before a blank stone
altar.

10126.name: Mahn-Tor Temple Square

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10126.description:
A corner of the temple square where the pillars curve toward a stained-
glass window of the mountain at dawn. Pews of black wood stand in neat
rows, worn smooth by many hands. The square runs south and west from
here. Dust drifts in the coloured light.

10127.name: Mahn-Tor Temple Square

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Steam Temple.

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10127.description:
A broad stretch of the temple square beneath a high vaulted roof. The
doors of the steam temple stand north, wreathed in warm vapour that
curls along the floor. Colonnades lead east and west. Brass pipes run
along the walls and knock softly with heat.

10128.name: Mahn-Tor Temple Square

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10128.description:
A quiet corner of the temple square, where the colonnade is hung with
offerings of ribbons and small iron charms. The flagstones are cold
underfoot, and a chilly draught slides between the pillars. Ways lead
east and south. The air tastes faintly of wax.

10129.name: Mahn-Tor Temple Square

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Ice Temple.

10129.description:
The temple square grows colder here, the pillars rimmed with a pale
glittering rime. The doors of the ice temple stand west, while the
colonnade runs north and south. Breath hangs in white plumes. The floor
is gritty with frost.

10130.name: Mahn-Tor Temple Square

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10130.description:
A shadowed alcove of the temple square, with niches holding statues of
long-dead lords of the mountain. A row of unlit candles waits on a stone
shelf. The colonnade runs north and east. A faint echo of chanting
drifts from deeper in the temple.

10131.name: Mahn-Tor Temple Square

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Water Temple.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10131.description:
The temple square slopes gently here, and the stones beneath your feet
are damp. A carved basin on a plinth overflows quietly and trickles into
a drain. The doors of the water temple stand south, with the colonnade
running east and west. The scent of wet earth fills the air.

10132.name: Mahn-Tor Temple Square

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10132.description:
A last corner of the temple square, its pillars scarred by a long-ago
fire. A heavy offering box of iron is chained to the wall. The colonnade
runs north and west. Charred beams overhead have been braced with new
timber.

10133.name: Mahn-Tor Steam Temple

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10133.description:
A hot, humid sanctum where veils of steam drift between carved pillars
of pale stone. Water trickles down the walls and hisses on iron grates
in the floor. The temple square lies south through an arched doorway.
Sweat beads on the skin, and the air smells of minerals and wet stone.

10134.name: Mahn-Tor Ice Temple

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10134.description:
A bitterly cold sanctum whose walls and altar are sheathed in thick
clear ice, glinting blue in the lamplight. Frost flowers bloom over the
carved pillars, and the floor is a sheet of slick glaze. The temple
square lies east through the doorway. Every breath stings, and the
silence is absolute.

10135.name: Mahn-Tor Water Temple

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Temple Square.

10135.description:
A cool chamber where a still pool of clear water fills a basin the size
of a cart, ringed by smooth white tiles. Reflected light ripples on the
vaulted ceiling. The temple square lies north through a low arch. The
air is moist and carries a mineral tang.

10136.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor West

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor West.

10136.description:
A crowded house where a long bench is spread with half-mended harness
and tools. Bunches of sage and thyme hang from the beams, and a kettle
hums on a trivet. The street lies south through the door. Boot-prints of
mud and straw cross the floor.

10137.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor West

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor West.

10137.description:
A modest house with a fireplace of rough stones and walls hung with worn
picks and hammers. A pair of heavy boots dries on a rack. Out the door
to the south lies the street. The air is warm and smells of tobacco.

10138.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor West

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor West.

10138.description:
A cheery little home with a scrubbed table, a pot of stew steaming on
the hob and a basket of eggs under a cloth. The door opens south onto
the street. Brass candlesticks gleam on the mantel, and a braided rug
lies before the fire.

10139.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor West

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor West.

10139.description:
A tiny house with a floor of swept earth and a bed built into the wall
like a ship's berth. A chipped crock, a pewter mug and a rolled-up map
sit on a shelf. The street lies north through the door. A thin draught
plays at the shutters.

10140.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor West

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor West.

10140.description:
A neat home with a flagged floor, a table with a checked cloth and a pot
of dried flowers. A narrow bed stands against the wall, made up tight
and square. A door set in the north wall gives back onto the street. A
sampler stitched with a mountain scene hangs above the hearth.

10141.name: A Small House in Mahn-Tor West

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor West.

10141.description:
A one-room home dominated by a loom, its threads strung taut in grey and
blue. Bundles of raw wool sit in baskets, and a stool is pulled up to a
half-finished blanket. The door opens north onto the street. A smell of
lanolin and lamp oil hangs about.

10142.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

10142.description:
The outer reach of the Great Hall, its pillars scorched by an old fire
and never fully cleaned. Tattered tapestries show a battle on a mountain
pass in faded thread. The hall runs north to the great junction and east
into the heart of the Great Hall. Cold seeps from the stone, and the
torches flicker in a draught.

10143.name: The Hall

east.description: To the east lies The Grand Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Hall.

10143.description:
The hall ends in a corner here, lit by a single smoking brazier on a
tripod. Old war-trophies hang on the walls: dented helms, a tattered
pennant, a cracked shield painted with a lion. The hall continues east,
and south it returns to the great junction. Dust gathers in the angles
of the vault, undisturbed by the watch.

10144.name: The Grand Hall

north.description: To the north lies A Small Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Grand Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Grand Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall.

10144.description:
A wider stretch of the Grand Hall, with pillars of dark granite marching
in pairs toward the roof. Long banners fall between them, each stitched
with the keep's mountain sigil. A narrow corridor leads north, the hall
carries on east and south, and west it returns to the plainer hall. The
air is cold and tastes faintly of iron.

10145.name: The Grand Hall

south.description: To the south lies Standing Before The Throne.

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Hall.

10145.description:
The Grand Hall bends toward the throne here, its floor inlaid with a
great black-and-white compass star worn by countless boots. Tall arched
windows, narrow as arrow-slits, let in thin blades of grey daylight. The
hall returns west, and south lies the approach to the throne. Heavy
chains and banners hang from the rafters.

10146.name: A Small Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Grand Hall.

10146.description:
A narrow, low corridor with walls of close-fitted blocks, so tight two
men cannot pass without turning sideways. A single lantern hangs from a
hook, swaying slightly in a draught from somewhere. South the corridor
opens into the Grand Hall; north it ends at the doors of the guard
quarters. Bootprints have scuffed the floor to a dull shine.

10147.name: Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters.

10147.description:
A barracks room lined with double bunks, each topped by a rolled blanket
and a hung belt. Boots stand in neat pairs, and the stone floor is swept
clean to the standard the Lord demands. The quarters continue north and
west, and the corridor lies south. A shaving mirror and a basin sit on a
shelf by the door.

10148.name: Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters

north.description: To the north lies Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters.

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters.

10148.description:
The quarters end in a small armoury alcove where spare shields and helms
hang in rows on pegs. A grindstone sits beside a bucket of dark water,
its rim bright with filings. Quarters continue north and east. Oil and
steel mingle sharply in the air.

10149.name: Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters

east.description: To the east lies Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters.

10149.description:
A narrow dormitory room, its bunks stacked three high and fitted with
canvas straps. A weapon rack holds practice swords of battered wood, and
a signal drum stands in the corner. Quarters lie east and south from
here. A cold draught whistles through a crack in the stone.

10150.name: Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters

south.description: To the south lies Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies Mahn-Tor Keep Guard Quarters.

10150.description:
The far corner of the barracks, where a long table and benches serve for
meals. Tin plates, stained mugs and a tally-board of duty rosters crowd
the wall. The smell of cold porridge lingers in the air. A way leads
south and another west through the quarters.

10162.name: Before The Gates Of Mahn-Tor

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Gates Of Mahn-Tor.

down.description: To the down lies On The Cliffside.

10162.description:
Two squat towers of black stone flank the great iron-banded gates of
Mahn-Tor, their crenels bristling with spears and snapping pennants. The
mountain wind slams against the walls and sets the banners cracking like
whips. Beyond the heavy doors, which stand to the south, the sounds of
the town drift out: hammer-ring and barked orders. A rough track drops
down the cliffside from here.

10163.name: The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor

east.description: To the east lies Inside The Gates Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10163.description:
The street turns a corner here, hemmed in by the high wall of the town
on one side. A shuttered house leans against the stones, and a rusted
lantern bracket juts from its angle. The gate court lies east, while the
street runs south. Meltwater drips from the eaves, and the cobbles are
slick.

10164.name: Inside The Gates Of Mahn-Tor

north.description: To the north lies Before The Gates Of Mahn-Tor.

east.description: To the east lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies The Entrance Square Of Mahn-Tor.

west.description: To the west lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10164.description:
Inside the gates a broad cobbled court opens, hemmed by sentry walks
where armoured men pace in pairs. Banners of the keep hang from iron
brackets, stiff and darkened by weather. Passages lead off in every
direction: the gate doors lie north, a street runs east, another runs
west, and an open square lies south. The cobbles are worn into shallow
troughs by a thousand marching boots.

10165.name: The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor

south.description: To the south lies The Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

west.description: To the west lies Inside The Gates Of Mahn-Tor.

10165.description:
A cramped street of grey stone houses bends here beneath the shadow of
the keep's high walls. Shutters are barred against the wind, and a bell
somewhere above counts the watch in slow, flat strokes. The gate court
lies to the west, while the street runs on south between leaning gables.
Soot from many chimneys streaks the lintels.

10166.name: The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor

north.description: To the north lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

east.description: To the east lies The Entrance Square Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies The Inn Of The Broken Horn.

west.description: To the west lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10166.description:
A crossing of cobbled streets lined with tall stone houses whose upper
floors lean out to touch overhead. Washing hangs stiff from a line, and
a worn doorstep sits beside a rain barrel. Streets run north, east and
west, and a painted inn sign swings to the south. The wind funnels along
the lane with a thin, steady whistle.

10167.name: The Entrance Square Of Mahn-Tor

north.description: To the north lies Inside The Gates Of Mahn-Tor.

east.description: To the east lies The Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies The Mahn-Tor Equipment Shop.

west.description: To the west lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10167.description:
A paved square just inside the town, ringed by sturdy buildings and
watched from a high wall-walk. A dry stone fountain stands at its
centre, its basin filled with wind-blown leaves. The gate court lies
north, a busy street runs east, another runs west, and the equipment
shop stands south. Boots and hooves have worn dark paths across the
flags.

10168.name: The Streets Of Mahn-Tor

north.description: To the north lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

east.description: To the east lies The Road To The Keep Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies The Mahn-Tor General Store.

west.description: To the west lies The Entrance Square Of Mahn-Tor.

10168.description:
Streets meet at a crooked junction where a stone trough, rimmed with
rime, stands beside a post hung with notices of the Lord's decrees. A
road climbs east toward the keep and the dark mouth of its cave, while
the entrance square lies west. To the south a shop door swings on iron
hinges beneath a painted sign for the general store, and north the
street leads back toward the gate court. The wind carries the smell of
coal smoke and horses.

10169.name: The Inn Of The Broken Horn

north.description: To the north lies The City Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10169.description:
A low, smoky taproom, with a great antler horn snapped in half and
nailed above the hearth. Rough tables are ringed with mug-stains, and a
fire of pine logs pops in the grate. A stair climbs into the dark of the
upper floor, and the street lies north through the door. The smells of
stew, spilt ale and wet wool warm the place.

10170.name: The Mahn-Tor Equipment Shop

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance Square Of Mahn-Tor.

10170.description:
A cluttered shop where mail shirts hang from beams and swords stand
upright in barrels. A workbench at the back is spread with files, rivets
and strips of leather, and a forge ticks as it cools. The doorway north
opens onto the entrance square. The heavy smells of oil, rust and
leather fill the room.

10171.name: The Mahn-Tor General Store

north.description: To the north lies The Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10171.description:
Shelves crowd this narrow shop from floor to rafters with rope, tallow,
lamp oil, tinned goods and bundles of dried meat. A counter of scarred
oak holds a brass scale and a heap of ledgers. Sacks of grain lean in
the corner, and a stove ticks in the back. The street lies north through
the door, where the cold wind waits.

10172.name: Gorak's Training Room

east.description: To the east lies The Guarded Hall.

10172.description:
A bare hall of packed earth and scarred wood, built for drill and
sparring. Straw dummies hang from chains, pierced and slashed, and racks
of blunted blades line the walls. The door east leads back to the
guarded hall. The floor is dark with old sweat, and the clash of steel
seems to hang in the air.

10173.name: Darkoth's Dark Study

east.description: To the east lies The Guarded Hall.

10173.description:
A dim study where every shutter is closed and the only light is a pair
of black candles on a heavy writing desk. Shelves of bound scrolls climb
the walls into shadow, and a stuffed raven stares from a perch. The door
east opens upon the guarded hall. A dry rustling, as of paper turning,
seems to follow the unwary.

10174.name: Tyrgoth's Inner Sanctum

east.description: To the east lies The Guarded Hall.

10174.description:
A dim, windowless sanctum hung with black cloth, where a single bronze
brazier glows like a coal eye. Sigils of the mountain and the blade are
scratched into the stone floor in a wide ring. The way east leads back
to the guarded hall. Silence presses on the ears, and the air smells of
cold ash and iron.

10175.name: The Road To The Keep Of Mahn-Tor

east.description: To the east lies Before The Cave Of Mahn-Tor.

west.description: To the west lies The Streets Of Mahn-Tor.

10175.description:
The road to the keep climbs steeply along the mountain's flank, paved
with chipped flagstones and lined by black iron torch-posts. The cliff
drops away on one hand, and the wind tugs hard at cloaks and hems. Far
overhead the towers of the keep stand grey against the sky. The road
runs east toward a dark cavern mouth in the rock, while the town streets
lie west.

10176.name: A Small Guard House

south.description: To the south lies Before The Cave Of Mahn-Tor.

10176.description:
A cramped guardroom with a low timbered ceiling, warmed by a small iron
stove that ticks and glows. A rough table is scarred with dice and
knife-marks, and a bench runs along the wall beneath a rack of pikes. A
slit window shows only a stripe of grey sky. The only way out is back
south into the chamber before the cave.

10177.name: Before The Cave Of Mahn-Tor

north.description: To the north lies A Small Guard House.

east.description: To the east lies The Entryway To The Cave Of Mahn-Tor.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Guard House.

west.description: To the west lies The Road To The Keep Of Mahn-Tor.

10177.description:
A stone-flagged guard chamber stands before the great cave mouth, its
walls hung with shields and rusted chain. Torches gutter in iron
cressets, throwing long shadows across a rack of spears. Small guard
houses open to the north and south, and a heavy door set in the rock
leads east into the entryway. The road outside lies west, and the sound
of wind comes in with every opening of the door.

10178.name: A Small Guard House

north.description: To the north lies Before The Cave Of Mahn-Tor.

10178.description:
Another guard house, narrower than its twin, with a bunk, a stack of
firewood and a ledger nailed to the wall listing the watches. The air is
thick with pipe-smoke, wet wool and lamp oil. A shuttered arrow-slit
looks out over the road. The doorway north opens back onto the chamber
before the cave.

10179.name: The Entryway To The Cave Of Mahn-Tor

east.description: To the east lies The Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Before The Cave Of Mahn-Tor.

10179.description:
The passage here is rough-hewn rock, a natural cavern squared off and
shored by generations of masons. Iron-bound beams hold up the roof, and
water seeps down the cave walls to pool in cracks of the floor.
Torchlight shows banners of the keep hanging limp in the still air. A
heavy door stands open to the west, and the passage runs on east into
the halls of the keep.

10180.name: The Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Grand Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Entryway To The Cave Of Mahn-Tor.

10180.description:
A great junction of the keep's lower halls, where torch-lit passages
meet beneath a vaulted ceiling blackened by smoke. Flagstones ring under
every step, and carved lintels bear the keep's emblem, a mountain split
by a blade. The entryway lies west, while halls lead north, south and
east into the heart of the keep. A chill that smells of old stone seeps
from the walls.

10181.name: The Grand Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Standing Before The Throne.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall.

10181.description:
A broad stretch of the Grand Hall, its pillars thick as old oaks and
capped with carved eagles. Tall banners of crimson and black droop
between them, and a long carpet runs down the centre. North the hall
climbs on, east lies the throne, south lies the Great Hall, and west the
plainer hall.

10182.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Guard Post.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

10182.description:
A crossing in the Great Hall, where torchlight from four directions
meets on the polished floor. A mighty iron chandelier hangs from a chain
overhead, its candles unlit. The Grand Hall opens north, the hall runs
east and west, and the guard post lies south. Statues of armoured
warriors line the walls.

10183.name: Standing Before The Throne

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Secret Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Hall.

10183.description:
The hall ends before a dais of black marble, where an iron throne rises
beneath a canopy of tattered war-banners. Braziers burn to either side,
and the flagstones are polished by the nervous feet of petitioners. A
hall runs north, the Grand Hall opens west, another great hall opens
south, and a plain door east is set into the wall behind the dais. The
silence here is heavy and watchful.

10184.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies Standing Before The Throne.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

10184.description:
A long hall of rough stone pillars, with a high roof lost in smoke. Rows
of oak benches stand empty along the walls, and a long board table bears
the scars of many feasts. The way north leads to the throne room, and
the hall continues west. Wind moans faintly through a flue in the vault.

10185.name: The Secret Hallway

east.description: To the east lies Entry To The Royal Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies Standing Before The Throne.

10185.description:
A narrow hidden passage behind the throne, lit by a single guttering
sconce. The stone walls are bare and damp, with scrapes where hands have
steadied themselves in the dark. West the passage returns to the throne
room through a concealed door; east it runs on toward the royal
chambers. Dust lies thick in the corners, and the air is close and
still.

10186.name: Entry To The Royal Chambers

east.description: To the east lies The Main Living Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Harem Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Secret Hallway.

10186.description:
A modest antechamber hung with dark red drapes, its floor covered by a
thick rug of mountain bearskin. Silver lamps cast a soft light over a
carved chest and a pair of high-backed chairs. The secret hallway lies
west, a living room opens east, and a curtained doorway leads south. The
air smells of wax and old perfume.

10187.name: The Guard Post

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Guarded Hall.

10187.description:
A fortified checkpoint across the hall, with an iron portcullis set into
the ceiling and a heavy bar-table to one side. Spears and halberds stand
in racks, and a brass-bound ledger lists those allowed beyond. The Great
Hall lies north, and the guarded hall lies south. The place smells of
leather and lamp oil.

10188.name: The Guarded Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Guard Post.

east.description: To the east lies Sumaron's Sanctum.

south.description: To the south lies The Guarded Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Gorak's Training Room.

10188.description:
A long hall of grim, unadorned stone, patrolled day and night, with
iron-studded doors in its walls. Torches burn in sconces at regular
intervals, each flame leaning in the draught. The guard post lies north,
the hall goes on south, and doors stand east and west. A faint scent of
burnt herbs drifts from the east door.

10189.name: The Guarded Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Guarded Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Amyrok's Arcane Study.

south.description: To the south lies The Guarded Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Darkoth's Dark Study.

10189.description:
A stretch of the guarded hall where the torches burn lower and the stone
is scored with old sword-nicks. Doors of dark oak stand in the east and
west walls, each bound in black iron. The hall runs on north and south
from here. A draught sighs along the floor, carrying a smell of candle-
wax and ink.

10190.name: Sumaron's Sanctum

west.description: To the west lies The Guarded Hall.

10190.description:
A cramped private chamber, with a narrow cot, a locked chest and a desk
laid with maps. Weapons and trophies crowd the walls, and a single
narrow window admits a stripe of daylight. The only way out is the door
west to the guarded hall. A scent of oiled leather and stale pipe
lingers.

10191.name: Amyrok's Arcane Study

west.description: To the west lies The Guarded Hall.

10191.description:
A round study crowded with shelves of cracked leather books, glass vials
and brass instruments of unknown use. Pale witch-lights drift beneath
the ceiling and cast restless shadows over a table scrawled with chalk
sigils. The door west leads back to the guarded hall. The air hums
faintly and smells of ozone and burnt sage.

10192.name: The Guarded Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Guarded Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Nasturn's Humble Abode.

south.description: To the south lies The End Of The Guarded Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Tyrgoth's Inner Sanctum.

10192.description:
Here the guarded hall narrows, its ceiling lowered and its torches set
closer together. A doorway of heavy planks stands in each side wall,
east and west. The hall runs north toward the guard post and south
toward its end. The flagstones are damp and carry the cold smell of deep
rock.

10193.name: The Harem Room

north.description: To the north lies Entry To The Royal Chambers.

east.description: To the east lies The Master Bedroom.

10193.description:
A languid room of silk cushions, low couches and brass lamps shaped like
lotus blossoms, so out of place in this stern keep. Heavy curtains of
green and gold muffle the sounds of the halls. The antechamber lies
north, and a bedchamber lies east. Incense smoulders in a small bowl,
and the rugs underfoot are thick and soft.

10194.name: Nasturn's Humble Abode

west.description: To the west lies The Guarded Hall.

10194.description:
A small, spartan room that lives up to its name, with a straw pallet, a
clay jug and a single three-legged stool. A tin cup hangs from a nail
beside a crude carving of a mountain goat. The door west opens onto the
guarded hall. Everything is tidy, as if the occupant expects inspection
at any moment.

10195.name: The Main Living Room

south.description: To the south lies The Master Bedroom.

west.description: To the west lies Entry To The Royal Chambers.

10195.description:
A comfortable room in sharp contrast to the cold halls, furnished with
deep leather chairs and a hearth of carved stone. A fire crackles low,
and a map of the mountain holds is pinned above the mantel. The
antechamber lies west, and a bedchamber lies south. Silver goblets and a
half-played game of tiles sit on a low table.

10196.name: The Master Bedroom

north.description: To the north lies The Main Living Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Harem Room.

10196.description:
A great bed hung with heavy curtains dominates the room, its posts
carved with climbing wolves. A wardrobe, a washstand and a rack of
ceremonial swords crowd the walls, and the shutters are bolted tight
against the wind. The living room lies north and a perfumed room west. A
faint odour of tallow and pine-smoke clings to the bedding.

10197.name: The End Of The Guarded Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Guarded Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Dorgar's Dismal Domicile.

west.description: To the west lies Belrak's Green Room.

10197.description:
The guarded hall comes to a blunt end at a wall of bare grey blocks. An
iron lantern hangs on a chain, and old shields are mounted beneath it as
if to say nothing passes. The hall returns north, while doors stand east
and west. Gouges in the floor show where heavy things were dragged.

10198.name: Dorgar's Dismal Domicile

west.description: To the west lies The End Of The Guarded Hall.

10198.description:
A gloomy cell of a room, with damp-stained walls and a low ceiling that
presses on the head. A pile of dirty blankets lies in one corner, and a
rusted lantern gives scant light. The door west leads out to the end of
the guarded hall. The floor is sticky, and the air smells of mildew and
sour ale.

10199.name: Belrak's Green Room

east.description: To the east lies The End Of The Guarded Hall.

10199.description:
A room painted in a once-bright shade of green, now flaking in great
curls from the plaster. Moss-coloured curtains frame a shuttered window,
and a threadbare rug lies before a cold hearth. The only way out is the
door east, back to the end of the guarded hall. Dried herbs hang from
the rafters in rustling bunches.

644700.name: town guard watchman soldier
644700.long_desc: A Mahn-Tor town guard stands at his post, one hand on the haft of a spear.
644700.description:
A hard-faced man in a grey surcoat marked with the mountain-and-blade
sigil. He watches every stranger with narrowed, wind-reddened eyes, and
does not move unless he must.

644701.name: market merchant trader townsman
644701.long_desc: A weathered merchant haggles quietly over a crate of goods.
644701.description:
A stocky trader wrapped against the cold in layers of wool and fur. His
fingers are stained with tar and his eyes miss nothing about a
customer's purse.

644702.name: keep soldier guard garrison
644702.long_desc: A keep soldier in black mail paces the hall, halberd on his shoulder.
644702.description:
A broad-shouldered man in blackened mail, a crimson sash cinched at his
waist. His halberd is notched from long use, and he looks eager for an
excuse to swing it.

644703.name: keep warden guard captain
644703.long_desc: A keep warden in heavy plate stands watch, his gaze fixed on all who pass.
644703.description:
A towering guard in plate etched with the keep's sigil, his visor raised
to show a scarred, unsmiling face. He carries himself like a man who has
never been bested in the yard.

644704.name: battle mage battlemage wizard
644704.long_desc: A keep battle-mage murmurs over a glowing sigil, sparks dancing at his fingertips.
644704.description:
A gaunt mage in a charcoal robe, his hands stained with ink and scorch-
marks. Tiny blue sparks crawl along the iron rings he wears on every
finger.

644705.name: gorak drillmaster sergeant master
644705.long_desc: Gorak the Drillmaster glares from the middle of the yard, a great maul swinging from one fist.
644705.description:
A giant of a man with a shaven head and a neck like a stump, his arms
mottled with old scars. He has broken the bones of a hundred recruits
and looks ready to add another.

644706.name: lord mahn-tor tyrant warlord
644706.long_desc: The Lord of Mahn-Tor sits upon his iron throne, one gauntleted fist closed around a black sword.
644706.description:
A lean, grey-bearded lord in black plate beneath a mantle of crimson
wolfskin. His eyes are the colour of mountain ice, and he rules the keep
with a hand that has never once unclenched.

744700.name: halberd keep notched
744700.room_desc: A notched keep halberd lies here.
744700.description: A long-hafted halberd with a black iron head, stamped with the mountain-and-blade sigil. The edge has been honed so many times that it is thin as a razor.

744701.name: cloak grey hooded wolfskin
744701.room_desc: A grey hooded cloak lies crumpled here.
744701.description: A heavy woollen cloak lined with scruffy wolfskin, made to turn aside the wind of the high passes. It smells faintly of woodsmoke.

744702.name: cuirass plate warden breastplate
744702.room_desc: A black steel cuirass has been left here.
744702.description: A thick breastplate of blackened steel, etched with the sigil of the keep across its chest. The inner straps are worn soft with use.

744703.name: maul gorak iron great
744703.room_desc: A great iron maul lies here, dented from long use.
744703.description: A brutish maul with a head of dull iron and a haft wrapped in greasy leather. Years of broken training dummies have beaten the metal into a battered lump.

744704.name: crown iron lord mahn-tor circlet
744704.room_desc: A cold iron crown lies here, set with a single black stone.
744704.description: A heavy circlet of dark iron set with a single smoky stone. It is cold to the touch even beside a fire, and it weighs on the brow like a command.
